// src/reference: ADR-0034 copyable reference templates — scaffold ASSETS, not package source. They import '@metaobjectsdev/codegen-ts' (the consumer's view), so they are excluded from the package build and verified separately against the built public API — by test/reference-byte-identical.test.ts, which runs every template AND the built-in it was copied from over the fixture corpus and requires byte-identical output. Excluding a file from tsc means nothing else compiles or executes it, so that gate is the ONLY thing standing between a renamed engine export and an adopter's broken eject; a template added here without a line in it is unverified.
